free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the high-risk finding of a PI-RADS 5 lesion (18 mm) identified on the MRI, which is a primary driver for the expert consensus. This is further supported by the concerning PSA trajectory, which shows a steady rise from 0.6 ng/mL to 7.6 ng/mL. The evidence converged on this decision because the PI-RADS 5 finding and the PSA trend strongly support intervention, despite the lack of prior biopsy.
